ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-run (nightly/2026-03-17): runtime-bench p95 latency +23% vs baseline. Dashboard: https://redwood.in/ci/perf/2064123456 :warning:
arya: saw this, digging into logs, paging perf artifacts now
devon: can someone grab the nightly job artifacts link? I don't have access from my laptop
ci-bot: artifacts available: https://redwood.in/ci/artifacts/2064123456 (logs, profiler, traces)
sam: running a local repro against the same image and seed
arya: quick glance at the flamegraph shows a big spike around token ~512 in the scheduler path — looks like kernel wait increases
nyla: (typo) meant to say nyla: interesting — did we roll any scheduler/kernel changes in the last deploy? cc @leo
leo: no infra kernel changes since yesterday; I can repro on the same hw and run perf trace if helpful
devon: note: we merged the small-batch queuing tweak yesterday morning (PR 8030) that touched the batching/scheduler path
arya: good pointer. @sam can you try the run with the old batching behaviour disabled flag to confirm? e.g.
```bash
./run_bench --profile --disable-small-batch-scheduler --seed=42
```
sam: starting that now, ETA ~8m
(some minutes later)
sam: update: with --disable-small-batch-scheduler p95 is back to baseline (~-2% vs baseline). looks like the new scheduler path regressed latency :thumbsup:
nyla: ok assigning to devon to open a regression PR (rollback or patch). include perf diffs, artifact links and a short repro note
devon: on it. I'll open PR and tag eng-runtime + eng-infra for review. drafting now — will include the artifact links and the flamegraph screenshots. PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/8123
arya: also propose short-term mitigation: route canary traffic away from clusters using the new scheduler until we patch
leo: I can push a canary routing tweak to staging in ~15m, then promote once green
devon: thanks. follow-up action: schedule deeper kv-cache/latency profiling in the next nightly run to pinpoint root cause of scheduler contention
ci-bot: auto-created incident: https://redwood.in/incidents/INC-2064
nyla: great triage. I'll notify oncall in case we need an emergency rollback to prod after PR review
sam: will post final perf numbers after PR lands and tests run
arya: thanks team — updating the incident and adding a short summary to the runbook
sam: closing loop once PR merged and confirm baseline restored
